name: io.github.houtini-ai/ai-detect
description: Local AI-text detection: per-sentence and document scores from open detectors, on your own machine.

environmentVariables.name: AI_DETECT_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: Compute device: auto (default), cpu or cuda.

environmentVariables.name: AI_DETECT_PORT
environmentVariables.description: First port to try for the local dashboard (default 8765; the next free port is used if busy).

environmentVariables.name: AI_DETECT_HISTORY
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to stop saving scans to disk.

environmentVariables.name: AI_DETECT_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder for scan history and the engine log (default ~/.ai-detect).
